evidence.quote: This document consolidates all product, data, and ML requirements for the MicroDrama recommendation system on XstreamPlay app.

Reduces cognitive load: the user does not have to re-specify what they want to watch next.
Maintains mood: if they were engaged in a romance story, recommending action content breaks the immersion.
Increases CTR: contextually coherent recos get clicked more than random mixes.

source_registry.claim_scope: Google API pagination guidance used as an anchored contract example, not universal PRD policy.
Firebase product guidance on experiment objectives, duration, users, and meaningful results.
Microsoft Research evidence for trustworthy randomized online experimentation.
LinkedIn guidance on deterministic assignment, concurrent-experiment independence, and sample-ratio checks.
Google Cloud guidance on identifying privacy needs and data-lifecycle controls.
Microsoft guidance on context-dependent data protection impact assessment topics.
GOV.UK guidance on secure, privacy-respecting service delivery.
Google-published accessibility design and testing guidance.
LinkedIn guidance combining automated and manual accessibility testing.
GOV.UK guidance on ensuring intended users, including people with access needs, can use a service.
Google Cloud guidance on user-journey reliability objectives.
Microsoft guidance on measurable reliability targets for customer interactions.
GOV.UK guidance on reliable service operation, monitoring, testing, and response.
Google SRE guidance on staged launches, verification, ownership, and rollback.
Microsoft guidance on progressive, quality-gated deployment and recovery.
GitLab guidance on rollout outcomes, checks, monitoring, failure handling, and rollback.
LinkedIn evidence that batch and recent personalization signals can have compatible cadences.
